# math-router
Routable edition of 719 OpenAI math preprints (Apache-2.0). Unofficial. Python >= 3.10, stdlib only.
Route: python3 tools/route_v2.py --q "<question>" --index out/index --params out/params.json
Output: JSON shortlist [paper_id, anchor, score], <=2000 bytes; abstain.flag=true means weak match: check the top rows before concluding there is none.
Then open papers/ via catalogue/routes.tsv (id -> path); jump to the anchor.
Browse: catalogue/subjects.json. Protocol: AGENTS.md. Contact: Contact.md
